title: Brazilian Collard Greens with Bacon Recipe
ldName: Couve a Mineira | Brazilian Collard Greens with Bacon
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 bunch of collard greens (stems removed and thinly sliced)
1 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil
ldInstructionsRaw: Heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over medium to high heat
Add the bacon and cook until browned, about 3-4 mins
Add the onions and cook until transparent, about 2 mins
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about a minute
Turn ff the heat and add the collard greens and toss gently until the greens wilt, about 1 minute
htmlIngredientLines: 1 bunch of collard greens stems removed and thinly sliced
1-2 thick strips of smoked bacon diced
1 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil
